instruction: Using the 'Bubble_Sort_tutorial.docx' for reference, implement the 'bubbleSort' function in 'bubbleSort.py' on the Desktop to sort an array and count swaps, then save the sorted array and swap count to 'res.txt' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires implementing bubble sort with swap counting. Original array [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90] requires exactly 14 swaps to sort. Verified with Python simulation. Evaluator checks if res.txt contains '14' (the swap count).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Metric checks both sorted array [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90] AND swap count '14' are present in res.txt
Correct sorted array verification: Uses regex to extract all numbers and checks if sorted sequence appears in order (lines 27-34), handling flexible formatting
Precise swap count matching: Uses word boundary regex (\b14\b) to avoid false positives from substrings like '1414', '145', '214' (lines 41-45)
Proper logic flow: Returns 1.0 only when BOTH conditions are met (lines 47-51), correctly requiring complete task verification
Robust implementation: Handles various output formats by extracting numbers with regex, works with different whitespace/formatting styles
